text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин and Мэдзиро Райан agree
to let
Найс Нэйчер spend a day with
them to learn the
secret of their
strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As she accompanies them during their
training,
she finds that their strength
comes from their
mutual respect and
competition with each other.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер realizes that the key to
improving is
to observe the other racers
around her and use
that as motivation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen just up
ahead, her
desire to beat the two Mejiro
racers grows
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
